description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage government technology team as a Founding Forward Deployed Engineer, working directly with users in public safety and related fields. You will turn frontline challenges into practical software and product improvements that support sensitive investigative work.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work directly, often in person, with users to understand their most pressing problems.

 - Build pragmatic solutions, including targeted analyses and custom integrations, that prioritize user impact.

 - Translate customer insights into product direction, technical decisions, and shipped features.

 - Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities while delivering solutions in a fast-moving environment.

 - Travel 25% to 75% of the time to stay connected with users.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building and delivering production software systems.

 - Experience shipping software that addresses real user needs, including tailored analyses, integrations, or other focused solutions.

 - A track record of working directly with end users and translating their feedback into implemented features or technical decisions.

 - Experience in an early-stage startup and in fast-paced environments with changing requirements.

 - High autonomy, a bias toward action, and comfort solving open-ended problems.

 - Experience with regulated or sensitive domains, investigative workflows, evidence management, data analysis, or public sector technology is valuable.

 - Willingness to travel frequently and interest in government technology and public safety.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $130,000 to $215,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

Hybrid in the United States, with frequent travel.
